lines.en: I skim the sand surface with my fins working.

lines.zh: 沙太软，我一压就陷进去。
lines.en: The sand is soft and sinks under my weight.

lines.zh: 我一边游沙，一边看四周。
lines.en: I swim the sand and watch all around.
I slide down a sand ridge.
I keep low and my shadow is faint.

lines.zh: 我往前拱，沙就往两边掀。
lines.en: I push forward and the sand parts.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可随时能钻。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I can dive at any moment.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块埋在沙里的石头。
lines.en: I go around a stone half-buried in sand.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤和沙一个颜色，你踩不到我。
lines.en: My skin matches the sand; you cannot step on me.
I slide past one of my own.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下浅浅一道。
lines.en: I leave a shallow line on the sand.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边用鳍探地。
lines.en: I test the ground with a fin as I go.
I work round to the far side of the dune.
Grains roll under my belly.
I stop with my head just above the sand.
I sink a little deeper into the sand.
One dart and I am into the sand.

lines.zh: 我在沙下面走，看不见上面。
lines.en: Beneath the sand I travel blind.

lines.zh: 我和同类挤在一处沙窝。
lines.en: I press into a sand hollow with my kin.

lines.zh: 风把沙粒吹到我的背上。
lines.en: Wind blows grains onto my back.

lines.zh: 我旁边有几只同类，也伏着。
lines.en: A few of my kind lie nearby, also still.
The sun has made the sand hot.

lines.zh: 我把鳍贴在沙上，感觉震动。
lines.en: I lay a fin on the sand to feel tremors.
A bird circles overhead.
Slowly I bring my eyes up.
The shape of the dune has changed.

lines.zh: 我一下钻进沙里，只留尾迹。
lines.en: I dive into the sand and leave only a trail.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，沙从背上滑下去。
lines.en: I shudder and sand slides off my back.
There is an old channel here.
I breathe without a sound.

lines.zh: 有东西踩在沙上，沙在传。
lines.en: Something stepped on the sand. I feel it.
I bury most of myself.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块沙下面是空的。
lines.en: There is hollow space under the sand you tread.

lines.zh: 我一压沙就陷，只能贴着滑。
lines.en: The sand gives way, so I skim along it.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，我这身是沙色。
lines.en: You cannot see me. I am sand-colored.

lines.zh: 我露出眼睛，看你站多久。
lines.en: I show my eyes and see how long you stand.
It is safer inside the sand.
Crouch down and I may show myself.
There are seven or eight in my group.
To catch me you must dig first.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，我往后缩半格。
lines.en: When you crouch, I shrink back half a block.
You are blocking the wind on the slope.
One of my fins was stepped on.
I dive into the sand at once.
Blood under the sand does not show.

lines.zh: 我从沙里弹出来又钻回去。
lines.en: I burst out of the sand and dive back in.
I retreat a way and put my head out again.
A split opens along my tail fin.
The sand will cover this wound for me.
I recover a while under the sand.
The taste of blood mixes into the sand.
I can still burrow. That is enough.
That has been buried in the sand.
I catch a fishy smell.

lines.zh: 我把头探出去，又缩回来。
lines.en: I put my head out and draw it back.
It is on the sand surface, hard to take.
I root at it and miss.
That smell is too faint to bother with.

lines.zh: 我一口吞了，沙也进去了。
lines.en: I swallow it, sand and all.

lines.zh: 你把诱饵埋进沙里试试。
lines.en: Try burying the bait in the sand.
Taking that bite means a risk.
Once done I go back under.
Into the sand, and I vanish.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子底下钻出来。
lines.en: I come out from under your boot.

lines.zh: 沙一塌，我们都滑了一下。
lines.en: The sand gave and we both slid.
Do not press the sand with your hand.
One touch and I am under.

lines.zh: 这一点碰撞，我只晃了一下。
lines.en: That bump only rocked me.
You collapsed a sand ridge.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进你脚边的沙。
lines.en: I dive nose-first into the sand at your feet.
You kicked up a spray of sand.
I retreat half a block and stop.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷在我旁边的沙里。
lines.en: Your boot sank into the sand beside me.
I stopped behind your heel.
This group is all my own kind.
We lie pressed together.
The sand moves and the whole group moves.
One goes forward and the rest follow.
We cannot tell each other apart.

lines.zh: 有一天会有小的钻出来。
lines.en: One day the small ones will come up.
They are shorter than my fingers.
We leave the middle of the patch alone.
They learn to burrow in the sand.
That is how the group grows.
Half a fish on the sand.
I push at it with my snout.
Buried in the sand, I cannot find it.
I carry it a way.
I nudge the shell loose with my snout.
I spit out a little sand.
I nose at this bright thing.
It fell into a crevice in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把沙粒从鳃缝里滤出去。
lines.en: I sift the grains out through my gill slits.
I push it back under the sand.
Something is stepping on this sand.
The tremor reaches me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，只露出一双眼。
lines.en: I lift only my eyes above the sand.
It is two blocks off.

lines.zh: 沙的震动告诉我它踩在哪。
lines.en: The vibration tells me exactly where it stepped.
I draw my fins in.
I edge toward its feet.
Sand slides beneath me.
Its steps have stopped.
From here one dart reaches.
I track it just under the sand.
It moves slowly. So do I.

lines.zh: 它踩下去，沙把我挤了一下。
lines.en: It stepped and the sand pressed me.

lines.zh: 我顺着沙脊的阴影潜行。
lines.en: I move along the shadow of the dune ridge.
It looks down at the sand.
I stop dead.
It looked, then went on.
I edge forward half a block.
Its shadow lies on the sand.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑向你的脚跟。
lines.en: I slide along the sand toward your heel.

lines.zh: 我从沙里窜出来，咬它脚踝。
lines.en: I burst from the sand and bite its ankle.

lines.zh: 它一抬脚，我被带出沙面。
lines.en: It lifted its foot and brought me out.
I slap its leg with a fin.

lines.zh: 沙一盖，你就看不见我了。
lines.en: One cover of sand and you lose me.
It kicks and I dive back under.
I come up on the other side.
This one takes the back of its hand.
Sand sprays up and it cannot see.

lines.zh: 我把它的一只脚拖进沙里。
lines.en: I drag one of its feet into the sand.
It finds its footing and I sink again.

lines.zh: 我从沙面下钻出来，只露头。
lines.en: I come up through the sand, head only.
This dune is my ground.
The sand dips where I lie.

lines.zh: 我旁边有几个同伴也露了头。
lines.en: A few of my group show their heads too.

lines.zh: 风把我的背吹得很干净。
lines.en: The wind has cleaned my back.

lines.zh: 沙子一盖，我就看不见了。
lines.en: Sand covers me and I vanish.

lines.zh: 沙丘的边缘有一条旧痕。
lines.en: There is an old line at the dune's edge.
First I listen to the tremors.
This place is hot by day.

lines.zh: 我在沙上伏了半刻，才动。
lines.en: I lie still a while before moving.

lines.zh: 沙被烧得烫，我只能往外钻。
lines.en: The sand grew hot and I had to come out.
The sand collapsed and I fell with it.

lines.zh: 水灌进沙里，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water soaked the sand and I could not rise.
The blast tore the whole sand surface away.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎穿了沙，扎到我。
lines.en: An arrow went through the sand and found me.

lines.zh: 怪光让沙变硬，我钻不动。
lines.en: Strange light hardened the sand and I cannot burrow.

lines.zh: 沙上什么也没有，我饿了很久。
lines.en: Nothing on the sand. I have been hungry long.

lines.zh: 雷打进沙里，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning went into the sand and numbed me.
The sand beneath gave out and I fell.
